verdict.rationale: YPOG documents a dedicated IP/IT/Data Protection practice page that advises founders, startups and investors on building up and realizing IP assets, so there is an IP team of its own. However, the evidence never mentions trademarks, clearance searches, registration filings or brand enforcement, and the practice is combined with IT and data protection. Missing for 10: explicit trademark clearance services, trademark registration/prosecution, brand enforcement or litigation, a standalone trademark-focused team, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm handles trademark clearance, registration, and brand enforcement, documented as its own practice or team

citations.quote: we advise founders, startups and investors on building up and realizing those assets
